prediction_text: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 US presidential election: the conference-panel consensus reading — Clinton defeats Donald Trump on 8 November 2016, following the polling lead. Single-point timing: 8 Nov 2016.
basis:
Card bears no tradition field; decided by genre: mundane/election astrology panel (WP-004 ISAR conference panel, Costa Mesa, October 2016; most polls favour Clinton).
A multi-reader panel at a professional conference, read together with a consistent polling lead, is taken at face value as the master-consensus signal for this card; no contrary chart detail is given on the card to override it.
